headline: 80% of ML is data prep. Here's what that really looks like.
caption:
Most ML breathing room comes before the model is built.

Data prep is the unsung part of every successful project: collecting, cleaning, validating, and transforming data so models can actually learn.

In today’s carousel, I walk through the data lifecycle, show what 'clean data' really means, compare a before/after example, highlight the skills recruiters want, and share what to showcase in your portfolio.

What’s one data prep task you spend the most time on? Drop it below 👇
